externalSearchDecision: Retained evidence was sufficient for terminal dispositions. Target documents for the remaining gaps are future or would need multiple new inputs to establish a defensible band.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Average economics band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: ROE was higher historically and the Ke sensitivity can give a small positive spread.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: Product coverage and digital presence support differentiation, but neither an observed retention series nor comparable servicing economics bounds a durable advantage band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Kênh số cũng có tại TCB và VPB; sự hiện diện của sản phẩm chưa chứng minh lợi thế bền vững.
rubrics.missingInformation: Retention, churn and unit servicing cost using the same customer segment and period.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Compare segment retention and servicing costs over the cycle.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Adequate realization with material qualifications band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: High observed cash interest realization supports an adequate band despite weaker reserves.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Material vulnerabilities band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: PPOP and NII increased even as the interest expense burden rose.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Adequate band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Capital headroom is sensitive to RWA and management buffer; Q3 problem loans increased.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: The Q3 contractual gap and H1 collateral disclosures bound selected sensitivities only. Funding date, availability and rollover can change the sign.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Under existing scenarios the gap ranges from a shortfall to a surplus; the USD 500m facility announces a channel without establishing eligible net cash.
rubrics.missingInformation: Value date and amount available on the facility; eligible collateral, haircuts, overlapping flows and behavioral retention.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Rebuild a comparable 30-day liquidity ladder from dated, unencumbered incremental sources.

rubrics.explanation: Capital reverse stress and liquidity sensitivities are available. An assumed funding premium does not establish financing availability in a combined stress.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Basel-anchored sensitivities produce both surplus and shortfall; the H1 capital test cannot establish Q3 CAR after refinancing stress.
rubrics.missingInformation: Severe but plausible funding response, stress costs and same-scope post-stress capital.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Test funding and capital jointly using verified eligible sources and stress assumptions.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Limited/low-quality trend band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Book value per share grew; the period choice and provision baselines change the growth picture.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: Credit growth and improved quarterly NIM inform direction. The modeled 6% profit growth remains an assumption without a consistently bounded credit/NIM/provision/RWA path.
rubrics.counterEvidence: The normalized EPS path since FY2023 is nearly flat and retention depresses terminal ROE in the modeled case.
rubrics.missingInformation: Same-scope growth, margin, credit costs and capital/RWA assumptions sufficient to distinguish bands.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reconcile them in a documented bank forecast and test adjacent bands.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Weak incremental economics band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: FY2022 starting point yields positive incremental proxy; capital deployment lags remain relevant.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Mixed/cyclical/average band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Licensing and capital create barriers, while the digital channel creates contestability.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: The same-basis funding-cost proxies place ACB between TCB and VIB. This does not bound segment share or distribution strength.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Cost competitiveness can coexist with weaker access or share; digital distribution is common among peers.
rubrics.missingInformation: Comparable segment market share or defensible distribution-scale proxy with a common denominator.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Compare dated peer-normalized market share and distribution with funding costs.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Balanced normalized forward asymmetry band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Quarterly NIM and PPOP improved, but problem loans increased.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: The approved BANK method is justified P/B. The tested price premium is roughly 4–48%, with adjacent bands still plausible because sustainable ROE and Ke vary.
rubrics.counterEvidence: The optimistic case narrows the premium considerably. A low point in one selected scenario would be a different judgement from an evidence-supported bounded band.
rubrics.missingInformation: Defensible normalized ROE and equity-risk premium or a comparable long-run pricing cross-check.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Recompute the representative and conservative BANK valuations and verify that a defensible band survives the range.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Below 8% band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Exit price 28.405 gives 8.37% on the same dividends; terminal ROE needed for 8% is historically attainable, but needs a sustainable capital and earnings bridge.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Poor asymmetry band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Value is responsive to sustained profitability and Ke; the upper tested valuation narrows the negative spread.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: Resolution 4490 establishes the approval channel and general oversight. It does not resolve transaction-specific execution of controls.
rubrics.counterEvidence: The generally sound governance evidence coexists with an unresolved related-party question; missing public minutes do not imply misconduct.
rubrics.missingInformation: ACB Insurance conflict declaration, recusal, actual pricing or equivalent transaction-specific oversight.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Review a dated governance report or oversight record tied to the transaction.

rubrics.explanation: A separate related-party channel was identified. Actual exposure and mitigation effectiveness cannot be classified reliably.
rubrics.counterEvidence: The approval mechanism is a mitigating indicator. Funding, asset quality and capital are already addressed in FH.
rubrics.missingInformation: Actual gross and net exposure, commercial terms and safeguards.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Classify the residual channel once same-scope transaction values and controls are available.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the High uncertainty band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: A quantitative model and retained evidence provide anchors, while capital and terminal assumptions remain sensitive.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: Extent of capital increases and historical LNTT is documented. The ACBS comparison and productive deployment timing, including the AMC component, do not bound the resulting owner return.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Expanded ACBS lending coexists with lower 9M LNST in hindsight commentary. ACBA 168bn is LNTT and cannot stand in for LNST.
rubrics.missingInformation: Same-period consolidated ACBS and ACBA LNST plus capital deployment dates and amounts.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Align earnings comparators with weighted capital deployment; separate effects of timing and trading cycle.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Evidence does not demonstrate disciplined distribution band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Cash dividends were paid and H1 headroom can cover test distributions under some capital assumptions.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Disciplined neutral/accretive issuance band.
rubrics.counterEvidence: Account-level fractional rounding and actions outside the observed bridge can change economic effect.
rubrics.reassessmentCondition: Reassess only when new evidence changes the bound conditions.

rubrics.explanation: Carry forward the reviewed V3 lower supported point in the Evidence does not demonstrate real compounding band.
